meta.title: Cookie Janitor
meta.description: Expires stale dsh-auth sign-in cookies from the browser jar once the Cookie request header grows past 4 KiB, so an accumulation of per-port cookies can never reach Node's 16 KiB header limit (HTTP 431).

clear.title: Cookie Janitor
clear.nothing: This request carried no sign-in cookie.
clear.stats: Largest Cookie header seen: {bytes} B. Most sign-in cookies seen: {count}. Cookies pruned: {pruned}.
clear.reopen: Reopen the URL printed by DSH to sign in again.
